transcript: This free AI tool lets you turn any website into its own API, even if it doesn't have one. So, you no longer need to pay for scraping tools or expensive APIs, even for gated websites like LinkedIn, Instagram, or Reddit. It's called Reverse API Engineer, and it's a free and open source tool that plugs straight into your Claude Code. Just give it a website and tell it what data you want, and an AI agent will browse that site, read every request happening behind the scenes, and from that, build a clean API client that you can use to pull that data anytime you want. Plus, since it uses the same API that the site itself runs on, it doesn't break, even when the website changes its whole design. So if you want to try it yourselves, just comment "API" and I'll DM you the link directly.
